blocks.text: Jab amino acids aur nucleic acids se amino group (-NH₂) alag kiya jata hai aur woh H⁺ se mil jata hai to jigar (liver) mein ammonia (NH₃) banti hai. Ammonia bohat zehreeli (highly toxic) hai, is liye ise jaldi nikalna parta hai. Ek gram ammonia ko be-zarar (nontoxic) had tak patla karne ke liye 500 mL pani chahiye. Itna zyada pani sirf meethe pani ke janwar kharch kar sakte hain, maslan zyada tar machhliyan, protozoans, sponges aur coelenterates. Samundari janwar ammonia seedha pani mein chhor dete hain. Jo janwar apna bara nitrogen wala fuzla ammonia ki shakal mein nikalte hain unhen ammonotelic kehte hain.
